key_idea: Reachability only changes at lock endpoints, so cut the badge range at every x and y+1 and run one BFS per elementary interval.
sketch: Collect all x and y+1, sort and deduplicate to get at most 2L breakpoints. For each consecutive pair [p_k, p_{k+1}) every badge behaves identically, so BFS from S using only locks with x <= p_k <= y, and add the interval length if D is reached. Badges below the smallest x or above the largest y open nothing and are skipped. About 10^4 BFS runs of O(N+L) each, around 6e7 steps. Pitfalls: use y+1 (half-open intervals) and 64-bit for the count. Stress-tested against per-badge BFS with small B.
